_comment: The pinned upstream dependencies whose pin literal lives in THIS layer. Same shape as cat-harness's `upstream/upstream-pins.json`, and read by the same `bun run cat check:upstream-pins`. Every `pinnedIn` here resolves against the cat-harness-tools root. The pinned version is not stored here: it lives in the file the build reads. The `pdfjs` row moved here from the harness registry because bean `70lx` moved `scripts/pdf-viewer.ts` into this layer, and a harness row cannot name a file in the layer above it (folio-assistant#1481).

pins.title: pdf.js generic viewer (legacy build)
binds: cat-harness-tools/scripts/pdf-viewer.ts — `PDFJS_SHA256` must be re-measured with the version; `install` refuses a zip whose hash differs, so a bump without it fails the site build rather than shipping unverified bytes.

cat-harness-tools/scripts/pdf-viewer.ts `openShim` — listens for `webviewerloaded` on BOTH `document` and `parent.document` and calls `PDFViewerApplication.open({url})` after `initializedPromise`, and sets `defaultUrl` to empty. All three are pdf.js internals measured at v6.4.299 and again at v6.5.438; a rename leaves every embed an empty viewer while the build stays green.
cat-harness-tools/scripts/pdf-viewer.ts `patchViewerHtml` — anchors on `<script src="../build/pdf.mjs" type="module">` in `web/viewer.html`, and throws if it moved.
cat-harness-tools/scripts/pdf-viewer.ts `KEEP` — the release paths copied into the site; `install` throws on any that is missing.
